questions.questionText: Nhetembo dzeShona: Nyora mhinduro yakadzama yeA-Level inoongorora nyaya iyi uchishandisa zvinyorwa zveShona. Tsanangura humbowo, ongorora maitiro emunyori, uye ratidza kuti nyaya yacho inobatana sei nemagariro nematambudziko eZimbabwe nhasi.
questions.explanation: Mhinduro inotarisirwa kuve nepfungwa dzakarongeka, humbowo kubva muzvinyorwa, kuongorora kwete kungorondedzera, uye kushandiswa kwemazwi eShona akakodzera.
